selector.champion: Transient left abducens (cranial nerve VI) nerve palsy
selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of binocular horizontal diplopia with left lateral gaze and inability for the left eye to track beyond the midline, along with the images showing left-sided abducens nerve palsy, support this diagnosis. The condition's resolution by postoperative day 1 also suggests a transient cause.
